verdict.rationale: The 01 is an agent that executes code, browses the web, manages files and controls third-party software, so scoping what it may touch is a fair axis. The evidence shows no enforced allowlist or permission boundary. Editable profiles that customize behavior and the system message are an adjacent, advisory control, not an enforced limit on apps, surfaces or accounts.

support.subject: As an operator, I can limit which apps, surfaces, or accounts the agent may touch, and the limit is enforced, not advisory
